selection: On fitting recordings only, leave one contiguous released block out; select a camera only with >=4 blocks, positive OOF gain, and positive gain after removing its best block.
revision_reason: Unconditional pooled residuals improved some cameras but harmed others; test a training-only applicability rule rather than selecting named cameras on assessment answers.
status: Exploratory second recipe after inspection of first recipe results; previously examined dates are reused, not independent confirmation.
